description: the finder returns `not` explicitly (`User | not`, value form): wrong → `denied`, right → `welcome`.
rationale: #1471 review HIGH-1: JS gives `undefined` when a function falls off the end; the absence arm tested `=== null`, so a wrong password took the present arm. Falling off is refused (whether it means `not` is a language decision not taken for the bootstrap), and the absence test is `== null`.
